annotations.text:
Brand thesis: notices gaps and closes them.

Five concepts, not five colour schemes. Each hero is structured differently on purpose — a ledger table, a gap motif, a network diagram, a photograph, a tagged archive.
Bracketed labels mark where your real photographs and screenshots go. The one-line 'gap' descriptions in A and B are my guesses, not facts — those need your words.

Round 2 — four ways to honour Super Mario, ordered from most literal (F) to least (G, then H and I, which carry it in structure rather than pixels).

Same thesis underneath: notices gaps and closes them.

The homage uses colour, generic pixel type, and game ideas — levels, a score bar, a world map, a manual. No characters, logos, sprites or ? blocks: this site goes on job applications, and Nintendo is famously protective of its artwork.
The order on the staircase (F) and the map path (H) is my guess. The real chronology comes from you.
